lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 high-contrast vertical white lines with irregular spacing, most clearly defined in the mid-to-posterior torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the mid-torso and haunch regions terminate before reaching the ventral fringe or the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5-6 distinct white spots located on the lower lateral haunch and the upper section of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A series of three spots on the posterior haunch align to form a short diagonal geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate silhouette with a posterior-dorsal vector at the base, transitioning to a vertical-medial orientation at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.4 times the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping represents approximately 10-12% of the total longitudinal horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker on the lateral neck; prominent white facial chevron and cheek spots; long dark ventral hair fringe; white 'socks' on the lower limbs.
